visual_design.art_direction: Authored schema fixture: luminous observatory puzzle with engraved brass beacon tiles.

composition.desktop: Centered board; goal above and compact progress below.
composition.mobile: One responsive board with finger-sized tiles and wrapped instructions.
composition.focal_hierarchy: Beacon symbols first, progress second, short instructions third.

visual_design.world_and_surfaces: Engraved orbital paths and restrained stippled sky behind the playing tiles.

assets.name: Beacon tile
assets.silhouette: Circular light within a rounded brass housing
assets.detail_layers: Rim, inset enamel, glass highlight and illuminated core
assets.states: Unlit, focused, lit; persistent shape difference as well as color
assets.technique: Local inline SVG or CSS layers with no remote assets

interface.typography: System sans for instructions, tabular numerals for progress
interface.controls: Large labeled tiles with keyboard focus
interface.interaction_states: Pressed depth, focus outline, lit marker
interface.overlays: In-surface completion message preserving the board

visual_design.motion_and_feedback: Brief tile light transition; static equivalent under reduced motion.
visual_design.rendering_budget: Cache decorative background; update only changed tiles; no simulation clock needed.
quality_checks: Tiles have recognisable housings and internal detail
Focus and lit state differ without color alone
Mobile tiles remain readable without horizontal clipping

implementation_design.state_and_rules: dispatch owns phase, cell states and move count
implementation_design.rendering: render consumes state and never changes rules
implementation_design.interface: Scoped input handlers call dispatch and keep tile nodes stable
implementation_design.content_definitions: Tile definitions and palette are named constants
extension_points: Add board layouts through cell definitions without rewriting rendering
revision_invariants: Changing colors must preserve action semantics and restart behavior
